entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Order number VF-9827-C.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the order for the Aero Road Helmet. Can I ask why you're looking to return it?
The color is wrong. It's just not what I expected. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I understand. Getting the right color is important, especially for a new helmet. Let me just confirm the delivery date... okay, it looks like you received this 66 days ago.
Right. So, can I return it or not?
Yes, absolutely. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days, so you're well within that window. We want to ensure you're completely satisfied with your gear's safety and style.
Good. So what's the next step? Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just authorized the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just attach that to the original box and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
